[TITLE] Financial quarters? [QUESTION] Why does the financial quarter one start in October and not January? [ANSWER] It depends on the company. 
A calendar year corporation begins quarter one with January 1
A September year end (or fiscal year) corporation starts quarter one with October 1.

It is a preference of the company and their operations as to what time of year makes for the best year end.

A C or regular corporation can choose any month as their year end. An S (or Subchapter S) corporation is limited to any month from September through December unless they were grandfathered in many years ago. The US federal government has a September year end.

[TITLE] i have heard that you can insure your car for 1 month at a time but i dont know who through,? [QUESTION] [ANSWER] Here are two Insurance Companies that offer 1 month insurance policies:
Dairyland
Affirmative.
I don't know what State you are in so I cannot verify if either of these Companies write policies in your State. There is a huge disadvantage to writing a 1 month policy though-NO GRACE PERIOD. If you decide you want to keep insurance for another month then your renewal payment (you renew these policies each month) has to be received by the Insurance Company on or before the date your month of coverage expires. If it is not received then you have no coverage and may have to fill out a whole new application.Much better to go with a 6 month policy and pay a monthly premium, at least if your payment is late you have a few days grace period. Lots of Insurance Companies (including the 2 I mentioned) have 6 month policies where the downpayment is around $40-$60 (liability only coverage). The 1 month policies cost around the same price so you aren't gaining any advantage.

[TITLE] How did WWII Influence Australia? [QUESTION] Society, Laws, culture, Government etc [ANSWER] We went to war the day after Britain declared war in 1939. We were supporting our mates even though we were not personally threatened by Hitler.

When the War came to the Pacific, then we knew what it was to fight for self preservation a bit more. Aussies that were already in Europe stayed there, but new recruits were sent to the tropics.

Apart from about 30 bombing raids onto the *northern towns and a couple of 2 man subs in Sydney harbour, Australia has never had battles on our own soil. 
There was also a mass prison break by Japanese POWs in a country town (Cowra). The casualties were heavy for the Japanese that prefered death to surrender - the Bushido code. 

Australian cities were used for R&R by US military, so we had our share of young boys getting lunch and the soldiers asking about the women in their house. 
"Hey, Mister. My dad got angry at my sister after you left last night. I heard them yelling. Could you give her back her virginity, please?"

Australians suffered in Japanese POW camps, and left a deep resentment there. My dad was in Singapore when it fell and worked on the Burma railway. When he came back to Australia, he was kept in hospital to beef him up a bit ... he was given 13 meals a day - the smallest being a teaspoon of something, the largest being 2 glasses of beer.

Britain wanted greater commitment to Europe and made some painful decissions in Asia for us. That saw the aussie government draw further from UK.

After WW II, many Europeans migrated to Australia. While many European cities were in rubble, Australia was mostly unscathed.

*Northern towns include Darwin (26 times), and west to Broome - sorry i didn't make that clearer, Dave

[TITLE] what is prayer? [QUESTION] [ANSWER] For me, prayer is a surge of the heart; it is a simple look turned toward heaven, it is a cry of recognition and of love, embracing both trial and joy.

Prayer is the raising of one's mind and heart to God or the requesting of good things from God. But when we pray, do we speak from the height of our pride and will, or out of the depths of a humble and contrite heart? He who humbles himself will be exalted; humility is the foundation of prayer, Only when we humbly acknowledge that "we do not know how to pray as we ought," (Rom 8:26) are we ready to receive freely the gift of prayer. Man is a beggar before God. 

"If you knew the gift of God!" (Jn 4:10) The wonder of prayer is revealed beside the well where we come seeking water: there, Christ comes to meet every human being. It is he who first seeks us and asks us for a drink. Jesus thirsts; his asking arises from the depths of God's desire for us. Whether we realize it or not, prayer is the encounter of God's thirst with ours. God thirsts that we may thirst for him. 

"You would have asked him, and he would have given you living water." (Jn 4:10) Paradoxically our prayer of petition is a response to the plea of the living God: "They have forsaken me, the fountain of living waters, and hewn out cisterns for themselves, broken cisterns that can hold no water!" (Jer 2:13) Prayer is the response of faith to the free promise of salvation and also a response of love to the thirst of the only Son of God.

[TITLE] Average Penis Size? [QUESTION] My b-friends is 8 and im happy... but i cant help but not beleive that 5-6 inches is normal... is this true? [ANSWER] Man, are a lot of these people so misinformed about what is really average or what? 

I've read a lot of different surveys about penis averages. Some say that the average is anything between 5-7 inches, some other surveys indicate an average of 5 1/2 - 6 1/2 inches. But those are not true averages, there can be only ONE average number. What they really are giving us, are average ranges. 

Which means that if you use the 5-7 inches range and you have a 5 inches penis, 80-90% of the men have longer penis than you, and 10-20% of the men have or shorter penis than you do. If your penis is 7 inches, 20-30% of the men have the same or longer penis than you do, and 70-80% of the men have a shorter penis than you. FYI, anything under 2.7 inches long erect or 2..76” in girth, is consider a Micro Penis.

Remember, that when a single "average measurement" is listed, that means approximately 50% of men are shorter than this number (and about 50% are larger). Less than 1% of males are exactly average. That means less than 1 out of 100 men will match the average number exactly. Beware that averages are actually known as "statistical means" and they are typically used in the context of medicine and statistical sciences rather than personal counseling. 

Also, note that studies that have relied on self-measurement, including those from Internet surveys, consistently reported a higher average than those which used medical or scientific researchers to perform the measurements.

There are four studies that made news when each came out, and these have a single digit average instead of a range. 

The first one is the famous Kinsey Sex Institute study. In the 1960s they asked over 3500 college males to measure themselves.
average penis length: 6 inch (15.2 cm) 
average penis girth: 5 inch (12.7 cm) 

Then there is the now famous Richard Edwards' Definitive Penis Size Survey Results with over 3000 participants.
average penis length: 6.3 inch (16 cm) 
average penis girth: 5.1 inch (13 cm) 

Another survey is the one done by Durex (just under 3000 participants):
average penis length: 6.4 inch (16.3 cm) 
average penis girth: 5.2 inch (13.3 cm) 

A more recent study was performed by Lifestyles Condom Co. in March 2001. They measured 300 college-aged students:
average penis length: 5.9 inch (15 cm) 
average penis girth: 5 inch (12.7 cm)
